map.输入样本均值、总体或样本标准差与样本量，并指定置信水平（如 95%），用 Z 分: Enter the sample mean, the population or sample standard deviation, and the sample size, specify a confidence level (say 95%), and estimate the confidence interval of the population mean with the Z distribution, returning the bounds — for large samples or known population standard deviations.
map.CI = x̄ ± z · s / √n；z 由置信水平按逆正态近似反解（双侧）: CI = x̄ ± z · s / √n, with z back-solved from the confidence level using an inverse-normal approximation (two-sided)
map.均值置信区间以样本均值 x̄ 为中心，加上/减去 z 值乘标准误 s/√n。z: The confidence interval for the mean is centred on the sample mean x̄, adding and subtracting z times the standard error s/√n. The z value is back-solved from the confidence level: taking α = (1 − cl/100)/2 as the tail probability and using an approximate standard normal quantile formula, so 95% gives z ≈ 1.96 and 99% gives z ≈ 2.576. It suits large samples or cases where the population standard deviation is known.
map.z=(x−μ)/σ 将数值转为标准分。: z = (x−μ)/σ converts a value into a standard score.
map.标准化后均值 0、标准差 1。: After standardization the mean is 0 and the standard deviation 1.
map.：x=115、μ=100、σ=15：z=1.0，高于均值 1 个标准差（约超过: : with x=115, μ=100, σ=15, z=1.0, one standard deviation above the mean (above about 84% of candidates).
map.：z=3.2：超出 ±3σ 常规界，判为潜在离群。: : z=3.2 is beyond the usual ±3σ limit, so it is judged a potential outlier.
map.由数值序列求样本标准差: Sample standard deviation from a data series
map.高于均值 2σ，正态下约超过 97.7% 数据（右尾 2.3%）。: Two sigma above the mean is above about 97.7% of normally distributed data (a 2.3% right tail).
map.消去量纲，使不同分布数据可比较（如身高 cm 与体重 kg 的 z 分可比）。: Removes units so data from different distributions become comparable (such as comparing z scores for height in cm and weight in kg).
